verdicts.reason: A pins the headline to the top and drops the CTA near the bottom, leaving roughly 400px of dead orange between them, so the headline and its button no longer read as one group. Its two-line headline also nearly touches the side edges. B keeps the original's three-line centred stack and has better balance, but the headline is set smaller than it should be for the taller canvas. The gap down to the CTA is still too large, and the pill button has shrunk until it looks a bit timid.
